answer.item: Jogo was born from the fear of the earth.

questions.question: What was Geto's plan for defeating the sorcerers?
questions.subject: Jogo/Synopsis

answer.item: Jogo asked Geto on how to defeat the sorcerers, with the curse user telling him that they first needed to seal Satoru Gojo and then they needed Sukuna on their side.

questions.question: How many of Sukuna's fingers was Jogo's strength equal to?
questions.subject: Jogo/Synopsis

answer.item: Jogo then asked Geto how many of Sukuna's fingers was his strength equal to, with the latter estimating eight or nine.

questions.question: What was the first step of Geto's plan to get Sukuna on the curses' side?
questions.subject: Jogo/Synopsis

answer.item: Jogo and Mahito decided to go with Geto's plan of getting Sukuna on their side, with the first step being to retrieve the fingers that were at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

questions.question: How did Jogo fight Gojo at the Shibuya station?
questions.subject: Jogo/Synopsis

answer.item: Using the crowd of humans as cover, Jogo engaged Gojo in hit-and-run tactics using domain amplification to stall for time.

questions.question: What did Jogo ask Sukuna to do after their fight?
questions.subject: Jogo/Synopsis

answer.item: Jogo asked Sukuna to make a binding vow that will give him permanent control over Yuji's body.
